content:
Jules (AE): Quick thread  partner request: Reseller margin approval for ChannelPartner One. They want 9% margin and 15% customer discount for a $120k ARR, 12-mo commit. Also requesting $7k MDF and co-sell credits. Need deal-desk & finance review.

Marco (Partner Lead): ChannelPartner One covers LATAM and will bring 3 mid-market logos. They say 9% margin is minimum to run their sales ops in region.

Ivy (Deal Desk): Summary:
- list discount requested: 15%
- reseller margin: 9% (exception request)
- MDF: $7k
- commit: $120k ARR, 12 months
Need finance to confirm net revenue impact and legal on MDF T&Cs.

Sam (Finance): Quick calc: net_first_year = 120k * 0.85 - 7k - (120k * 0.09) = 102k - 7k - 10.8k = 84.2k. Looks borderline but acceptable if partner pipeline shows >2x expansion. Please attach partner pipeline evidence.

legal-bot: Flag: MDF usage reporting & advertising approvals required. Also want reseller accreditation clause.

Marco (Partner Lead): Partner will fast-close if margin approved by EOD tomorrow. They provided pipeline doc (sent via email).

Ivy (Deal Desk): Proposed approval path: Finance -> Legal -> CRO. If finance signs off, I can provision a 9% one-off margin and schedule quarterly reconciliations. Otherwise fallback is 8% margin + 14% discount + $5k MDF.

Jules (AE): Attaching CRM opp id: https://crm.redwood.ai/opps/RED-4615. Also POC completed last week; product gave green on integration. Need to close before month-end.

Sam (Finance): I'll review pipeline and run sensitivity. If pipeline checks out, ok to approve 9% as a one-time exception with MDF cap and reporting.

legal-bot: Please submit draft contract for redlines. Expected legal review 24-48h.

Ivy (Deal Desk): Marking priority high and routing to approvers now.

Marco (Partner Lead): Thanks team 44d will hold partner conditional on update.
